text: Insulation: XLPE, 90 degC conductor temperature in continuous operation and 250 degC in short circuit; MV cables 6/10 (12) kV (for 10.5 kV) with copper tape screen; outer sheath of halogen-free flame-retardant material (LSZH) indoors, and UV-, chloride- and hydrocarbon-resistant sheath outdoors, direct burial and in the CW pump house; cables in the ground water zone shall have radial and longitudinal water blocking.
